name: When Kobe Bryant died, a piece of me died./当科比死了，我的一部分也死了。
vocabs: v.乱翻;乱动, get in, /ɡet ɪn/
prep.过了一段时间, over a period of time, /pɪriədəv taɪm/
v.过去常常, used to do, /ˈjuːst tə/
n.讨厌鬼, a pain in the ass, /æs/
v.接触, come in contact with, /a/
grammars: Kobe's family 强调家庭整体，所以用单数。如果强调家庭成员用复数更合适。

would 表示说话者对动作发生的不确定，翻译成会，是一种谦虚地表达观点的用法。常出现在假设句（普通或虚拟）的主句部分或疑问句。
If it is 8 o'clock, I will call her. 如果8点了，我将给她打电话。（确定动作发生）
If it is 8 o'clock, I would call her. 如果8点了，我会给她打电话。（普通假设）
If it was 8 o'clock, I would call her. 如果8点了，我会给她打电话。（虚拟）
If you love something, if you have a strong passion for something,  you would go to the extreme... （普通假设）
If I had a million, I would buy a luxury car. （虚拟）
If I had got there earlier, I would have met her. （虚拟）
This kid had passion like (If you tried to understand,) you would never know. （虚拟）
(If I followed my usual routine,) I would say good morning, but it’s afternoon. （虚拟。正常情况下，我每天说的是早上好，暗指与同事打招呼。）
Would you like a cup of coffee? （疑问句。你会愿意。。。吗？）

em dash（—）引导的句子用于补充说明前面的话，仍未完整句子的一部分。类似倒装句。
你吃饭了吗？VS 饭吃了吗你？
It was a nuisance - if I can say that word – but that nuisance turned into love over a period of time.
coke 指可乐这款饮料时不可数。指几瓶可乐时可数。
live 表示住和活时读 /lɪv/ 表示直播时读 /laɪv
But his attitude to compete and play against someone he felt like 这里的不定式 to do 翻译为: 愿意...乐于...
close 作动词时读音是 “克洛兹”，作形容词时读音是”克洛斯“
Bryant 的发音要点：B 要发爆破音"b饿", n的鼻音要有，t要轻
It was a nuisance 的 it 发音要点：/ɪt/ 较短且靠后，不能发成"意特"，应嘴张开让位置靠后类似"eit"
as big brother 的 as 发音要点：a 是小口埃，与 ə 接近
taught 的发音要点：嘴张开 /tɔːt/
live 与 leave 的发音区别：前者短音，后者长音
名词复数发音时要将单数因发全，再发s因，例如 baseballs = baseball + s
row 与 roll 的发音区别：前者尾音短且嘴圆。后者尾音长喉舌要卷起。

texts:
I'm grateful to Vanessa and the Bryant family for the opportunity to speak today.
感谢瓦妮莎和科比家人给我今天发言的机会。

I'm grateful to be here to honor Gigi and celebrate the gifts that Kobe gave us all -
感谢能在这里向Gigi致敬，赞颂科比给我们的礼物，

what he accomplished as a basketball player, as a businessman and a storyteller and as a father.
这是他作为一名篮球运动员，商人，故事诉说者，父亲所取得的成就。

In the game of basketball, in life as a parent,
在篮球比赛中，在生活中作为父亲，

Kobe left nothing in the tank. He left it all on the floor.
科比不遗余力。他将一切献给了球场。

Maybe it surprised people that Kobe and I were very close friends. But we were very close friends.
也许令人们惊讶的是，科比和我是非常亲密的朋友。但我们确实是非常亲密的朋友。

Kobe was my dear friend. He was like a little brother.
科比是我亲爱的朋友。他就像我的弟弟一样。

Everyone always wanted to talk about the comparisons between he and I.
大家总想拿他和我作比较。

I just wanted to talk about Kobe.
我只想谈谈科比。

You know all of us have brothers and sisters, little brothers, little sisters, who for whatever reason always tend to get in your stuff, your closet, your shoes, everything.
你们知道，我们都有哥哥姐姐，弟弟妹妹，他们总是出于某种原因喜欢翻你的东西，你的柜子，你的鞋，每样东西。

It was a nuisance – if I can say that word – but that nuisance turned into love over a period of time.
那是一种打扰行为要我说，但随着时间的推移，这种打扰变成了爱。

Just because the admiration that they have for you as big brothers or big sisters, the questions they're wanting to know every little detail about life that they were about to embark on.
就因为你作为哥哥或姐姐他们对你的钦佩你，他们想知道即将开始的生活的每一个细节。

He used to call me, text me, 11:30, 2:30, 3 o'clock in the morning, talking about post-up moves, footwork, and sometimes, the triangle.
他常常在凌晨 11 点半、2 点半、3 点给我打电话、发短信，讨论背身单打、脚步动作，有时还有三角进攻。

At first, it was an aggravation.
一开始，这很让人恼火。

But then it turned into a certain passion. This kid had passion like you would never know. 
但后来它变成了一种激情。这个孩子有一种可能你未曾见过的激情。

It's an amazing thing about passion. If you love something, if you have a strong passion for something, you would go to the extreme to try to understand or try to get it. 
那是一件关于激情的奇妙事情。如果你热爱某样事物，如果你对某样事物有强烈的热情，你会不遗余力地尝试理解或弄懂。

Either icecream, cokes, hamburgers, whatever you have a love for. If you have to walk, you would go get it. If you have to beg someone, you would go get it.
冰淇淋、可乐、汉堡包，任何你喜欢的东西。如果你要走路，你就会去弄懂它。如果你要求人，你就会去弄懂它。

What Kobe Bryant was to me was the inspiration that someone truly cared about the way either I played the game or the way that he wanted to play the game.
科比布莱恩特对我的鼓舞是，有人真正关心我打球的方式，或者他想要打球的方式

He wanted to be the best basketball player that he could be.
他想成为最好的篮球运动员。

And as I got to know him, I wanted to be the best big brother that I could be.
当我了解他时，我想成为最好的哥哥。

To do that, you have to put up with the aggravation, the late-night calls, or the dumb questions.
要做到这一点，你必须忍受恼怒、深夜电话或愚蠢的问题

I took great pride as I got to know Kobe Bryant that he was just trying to be a better person – a better basketball player.
当我认识科比布莱恩特时，我感到非常骄傲，他只是想成为一个更好的人——一个更好的篮球运动员。

We talked about business, we talked about family, we talked about everything.
我们谈论生意，谈论家庭，谈论一切。

And he was just trying to be a better person.
他只是想成为一个更好的人。

Now, he's got me and I'll have to look at another crying meme for the next.
现在，他抓住我了，我接下来我将不得不看另一个表情包。

I told my wife I wasn't gonna do this cause I didn't want to see that for the next three or four years.
我告诉妻子我不准备哭，因为我不想在接下来的三四年里看到新表情包。

That is what Kobe Bryant does to me.
这就是科比布莱恩特对我所做的。

I'm pretty sure Vanessa and his friends all can say the same thing - he knows how to get to you in a way that affects you personally, even though he's being a pain in the ass.
我很确定瓦妮莎和他的朋友都会说同样的故事 - 他知道如何以一种能影响你个人的方式来接近你，尽管他是个讨厌鬼。

But you have a sense of love for him and the way that he can bring out the best in you.
但你对他有一种喜爱，以及能激发出你最好一面的特质。

And he did that for me.
然后他确实影响了我。

I remember maybe a couple months ago he sends me a text and he said, "I'm trying to teach my daughter some moves.
我记得大概几个月前，他发给我一条信息说，“我正尝试教我女儿一些脚步”。

And I don't know what I was thinking or what I was working on,
然后我不知道我当时在想什么或在做什么，

but what were you thinking about when you were growing up trying to work on your moves?
但是，在你成长的过程中，尝试研究你的脚步时，你当时在想什么？

I said "What age?" He says "12".
我说”几岁“？他说12。

I said "12, I was trying to play baseball."
我说：”12岁，我在打棒球“

He sends me a text back saying "Laughing my ass off." And this is at 2 o'clock in the morning.
他给我回了一条短信说“笑死我了”。此时是凌晨 2 点。

But the thing about him was we could talk about anything that related to basketball but we could talk about anything that related to life.
但关于他的事情是，我们可以谈论任何与篮球有关的事情，也可以谈论任何与生活有关的事情。

And as we grew up in life, rarely have friends that we can have conversations like that. 
随着我们逐渐长大，我们很少有朋友可以像那样交谈。

Well, it's even rarer when you can grow up against adversaries and have conversations like that. 
嗯，更加罕见的是，你能够在与对手的对抗中成长，并进行这样的对话时。

I went and saw Phil Jackson in 1999, maybe 2000, I don't know, when Phil was here in L.A.
1999年，也许2000 年，我忘了，我去看菲尔·杰克逊，当时他在洛杉矶这。

And I walk in and Kobe's sitting there. And the first thing, Kobe said, "Did you bring your shoes?"
我走进去，科比坐在那里。科比说的第一句话就是：“你带鞋了吗？”

"No, I wasn't thinking about playing."
“不，我没想打球。”

But his attitude to compete and play against someone he felt like he could enhance and improve his game, that's what I loved about the kid.
但是他那种愿意与那些他认为能提高和改进他比赛水平的人去竞争和比赛的态度，就是我喜欢这个孩子的地方。

I absolutely loved the kid.
我非常爱这孩子。

No matter where he saw me, it was a challenge and I admired him because his passion.
无论他在哪看到我，这都是一个挑战。我佩服他的激情。

You rarely see someone who is looking and trying to improve each and every day, not just in sports, but as a parent, as a husband.
很少看到有人每天都在努力进步，不仅在体育方面，而且作为父母、作为丈夫。

I am inspired by what he's done, and what he's shared with Vanessa, and what he's shared with his kids.
他的事迹、他与瓦妮莎以及他的孩子们分享的一切都激励着我。

I have a daughter who's 30 and I became a grandparent. And I have two twins. I have twins at 6.
我有一个 30 岁的女儿，我也当上爷爷了。我有一对双胞胎。他们 6 岁。

I can't wait to get home to become a Girl Dad and to hug them and to see the love and smiles that they bring to us as parents.
我迫不及待地想回家变成一个奶爸，去拥抱她们，去感受她们给我们这些父母带来的爱和笑容。

He taught me that just by looking at this tonight, looking at how he responded and reacted with the people he actually loved.
他教我，今晚可以看一下，看看他是如何对待他真正爱的人。

These are the things that we will continue to learn from Kobe Bryant.
这些都是我们将从科比布身上继续学习的东西。

To Vanessa, Natalia, Bianka, Capri, my wife and I will keep you close in our hearts and our prayers. We will always be here for you. Always.
对于瓦妮莎和你们的孩子，我和我的妻子将把你们放在我们的心中，并为你们祈祷。我们将一直与你们同在，永远。

I also want to offer our condolences and support to all the families affected by this enormous tragedy.
我也想向所有受这场巨大悲剧影响的家庭表示哀悼和支持。

Kobe gave every last ounce of himself to whatever he was doing.
科比竭尽全力做好每件事。

After basketball, he showed a creative side to himself that I didn't think any of us knew he had.
退役之后，他展现出了自己富有创造力的一面，我想我们都没想他有着一面。

In retirement, he seemed so happy. He found new passions.
退休后，他看上去很快乐。他找到了新的激情。

And he continued to give back, as a coach, in his community.
作为一名教练，他继续回馈社区。

More importantly, he was an amazing dad, amazing husband, who dedicated himself to his family and who loved his daughters with all his heart.
更重要的是，他是一位出色的父亲、出色的丈夫，他全身心地投入到家庭中，全心全意地爱着他的女儿们。

Kobe never left anything on the court And I think that's what he would want for us to do.
科比在赛场上倾其所有，我认为他希望我们也这样做。

No one knows how much time we have.
没人知道我们还有多少时间。

That's why we must live in the moment, we must enjoy the moment, we must reach and see and spend as much time as we can with our families and friends and the people that we absolutely love.
这就是为什么我们必须活在当下，必须享受当下，必须尽可能多地陪伴我们的家人、朋友和我们深爱的人。

To live in the moment means to enjoy each and every one that we come in contact with. 
活在当下意味着享受我们接触到的每一个事物。

When Kobe Bryant died, a piece of me died.
当科比死了，我的一部分也随之死去。

And as I look in this arena and across the globe, a piece of you died, or else you wouldn't be here.
放眼这个球馆和全世界，你们的一部分也已经死了，否则你们就不会观看这场仪式。

Those are the memories that we have to live with and we learn from. 
这些记忆，我们必须铭记并从中汲取教训。

I promise you from this day forward, I will live with the memories of knowing that I had a little brother and I tried to help in every way I could.
从今天起我承诺，我会铭记我有一个弟弟，我以各种我能的方式努力帮过他。

Please, rest in peace little brother.
安息吧，弟弟。
